result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and stop-controlled approaches. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, pedestrian visibility is partially obstructed by a vehicle parked immediately adjacent to the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: A brown van is parked very close to the crosswalk, potentially blocking the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, parked at the curb next to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to improve pedestrian visibility and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential/mixed-use street with a marked zebra crosswalk across a two-lane roadway. While a sidewalk exists on the right side, the left side lacks a paved pedestrian path, and the crossing is uncontrolled by signals or stop signs.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any regulatory signage (stop signs) or signals to compel drivers to yield.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved surfaces.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs or a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) to alert drivers to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a continuous pedestrian network.

result.summary: The street provides continuous sidewalks on both sides, but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or curb ramps. The roadway is unmarked and exhibits significant pavement cracking, which may create trip hazards or encourage higher vehicle speeds due to the lack of lane definition.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway can pose trip hazards for pedestrians crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at intersections to provide designated pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this residential street.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked crosswalk with a curb ramp and a well-maintained sidewalk. However, the building on the left corner and parked vehicles on the right create significant sightline obstructions at the intersection.

hazards.name: Blind Corner
hazards.description: The building on the left corner is situated immediately adjacent to the sidewalk, blocking the view of approaching traffic for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right side of the street obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a raised crosswalk to physically slow vehicle speeds and increase the visibility of pedestrians.
